title: pvNetCDFCAMreader
body:
## pvNetCDFCAMreader

Reads Community Atmosphere Model (CAM) output on an unstructured horizontal grid from two NetCDF files: FileName holds the points and fields and ConnectivityFileName the cell connectivity. The output is an unstructured grid that is unstructured horizontally and layered vertically: quadrilaterals for one layer, hexahedra when several layers are read. VerticalDimension chooses single-layer, midpoint (lev) or interface (ilev) variables; ParaView's default is midpoint layers. Use pvNetCDFReader for CF-convention gridded files.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Both files are required; a connectivity file from a different grid gives wrong cells without an obvious error.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `NetCDFCAMreader`. Identity: `sources/NetCDFCAMReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellLayerRight` | **DEPRECATED in ParaView 4.4.** No longer needed/supported. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ConnectivityFileName` | This property specifies the file name to read for the grid connectivity. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `InterfaceLayerIndex` | Specifies which layer to load from the interface layers. Note that the layer indexes 0 to n-1 map to Z values n-1 to 0. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MidpointLayerIndex` | Specifies which layer to load from the midpoint layers. Note that the layer indexes 0 to n-1 map to Z values n-1 to 0. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | This property lists which NetCDF CAM point variables to load. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SingleInterfaceLayer` | Load only one layer from variables on the interface layers. The layer is specified by InterfaceLayerIndex. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SingleMidpointLayer` | Load only one layer from variables on the midpoint layers. The layer is specified by MidpointLayerIndex. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VerticalDimension` | Specify whether to read variables from the single layer, from midpoint layers or from interface layers. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Single layer [time, ncol]","Midpoint layers [time, lev, ncol]","Interface layers [time, ilev, ncol]"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Single layer [time, ncol]"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvNetCDFCAMreader",
  "options": {
    "ConnectivityFileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE",
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
